references.text: Moses instructs the Israelites not to go out on the Sabbath to gather manna, which reflects the warning in Matthew to avoid fleeing on the Sabbath.
The command to keep the Sabbath holy, emphasizing the importance of not traveling on the Sabbath as mentioned in Matthew.
The people of Israel's disdain for the Sabbath and their unjust actions, which may reflect the importance of honoring the Sabbath as mentioned in Matthew.
Jesus discusses the lawfulness of doing good on the Sabbath, which can be related to the necessity of fleeing for one's life even on the Sabbath in Matthew.
Jesus heals a woman on the Sabbath, challenging strict interpretations of what is permitted on the Sabbath, similar to Matthew's teaching about fleeing on the Sabbath.
The context of the flight mentioned in Matthew, where Jesus warns of great tribulation and the need to flee for one's life.
